title: Minneapolis Water Taxi
specs: Cruise downstream to St. Anthony Falls or upstream to Lowry Ave Bridge with skyline views
Up to 6 people per boat; reserve two boats for larger groups
includes: Captained cruise on electric powered boats
blurb: Guests enjoy a captained cruise downstream on the Mississippi River into Downtown Minneapolis or upstream towards the Lowry Ave Bridge with skyline views. Cruises are primarily private and pick up/drop off at Boom Island Park. Each cruise is 55 minutes long unless multiple hours are booked.
extraNote: Tips after cruise are accepted and appreciated · Boom Island Park, 724 Sibley St NE, Minneapolis, MN 55413
